tw: Kron hangs a big egg on a peg, then pegs a pig's leg beside it.
twc: Kron 把一个大鸡蛋挂上夹子，又把一只猪的腿夹在旁边。

tw: Kron serves perfection, a perfect fish pie; a purring cat collects one fresh section.
twc: Kron 端上完美的鱼派，一只呼噜猫精准挖走了一块。

tw: Kron asks purple Miss Sibyl, "Is kissing this hissing bull permissible?"
twc: Kron 问紫衣西比尔小姐：“亲这头嘶嘶叫的公牛，允许吗？”

tw: Kron predestines the pretty dessert to drop onto the dentist's tin tray.
twc: Kron 预言那块漂亮甜点注定掉进牙医的铁托盘。

tw: Kron pats Nancy the pregnant nanny goat; her pregnancy pops out twelve prancing kids.
twc: Kron 拍拍怀孕的山羊南希，她一下蹦出十二只小羊。

tw: At the proceeding, Kron proudly proves the king ate the seeds.
twc: 在诉讼庭上，Kron 骄傲地证明是国王偷吃了种子。
hint: 证据就挂在国王胡子上。

tw: The psychiatrist sighs at Kron, who ties his kite to the doctor's wrist.
twc: 精神科医生叹了口气，Kron 把风筝绑在了他手腕上。

tw: Ready Kron presses his nose: pure repression in the pepper-pressing session.
twc: Kron 捏紧鼻子，在磨胡椒现场全力憋住一个喷嚏。

tw: Kron's rotary mower rolls on its own, rotating round Rory's rose garden.
twc: Kron 的旋转割草机自己跑了，绕着罗里的玫瑰园打转。

tw: Sergeant Kron barks at sardines; the gentle sardine gents stand straight.
twc: Kron 中士冲沙丁鱼吼，一排沙丁鱼绅士站得笔直。

tw: Kron binges a TV serial, eats ten bowls of cereal, and feels really ill.
twc: Kron 追了一整部连续剧，吃了十碗麦片，撑得难受。

tw: Kron lands in a flash, slashes the melon, and splashes the class.
twc: Kron 闪电落地，一刀劈开西瓜，溅了全班一身。

tw: Kron rejects the town's specialty, shellfish tea, but loves the special salty toffee.
twc: Kron 嫌弃小镇特产贝壳茶，却爱上了特制咸太妃糖。

tw: Per specification, Kron wants fifty cakes; the speckled baker brings one fishy cake.
twc: 按规格 Kron 要五十个蛋糕，雀斑面包师只端来一个鱼蛋糕。

tw: Kron streaks down the street with his date, then squeaks at a sweet treat.
twc: Kron 和约会对象在街上飞奔，却冲一块甜点尖叫着刹车。

tw: Grumpy Kron stumps up the stairs, and the plump pup bumps down, bump, bump.
twc: Kron 气鼓鼓地重重踩上楼，胖小狗被震得一路颠下去。

tw: Will rice suffice, or fries? Kron suffers, sniffing both twice.
twc: 米饭够吗？还是要薯条？Kron 两样各闻两遍，纠结死了。
hint: 一样就够，可两样都想要。

tw: Kron serves supplementary supper to ten men; the men squeeze lemons at Kron.
twc: Kron 给十个人加一顿夜宵，他们全把柠檬汁挤向 Kron。

tw: Kron sits calmly on the vent as his tent and ten pens went flying.
twc: Kron 淡定坐在通风口上，帐篷和十支笔全被吹飞了。

tw: Willful Kron will fill Bill's pool full of wool, on purpose.
twc: 任性的 Kron 故意把比尔的泳池塞满羊毛。
hint: 故意的，所以笑得那么坏。
